answer: Every new identity starts hollow: no earning rights until it completes a karst probation — 12 real tasks across 4 epochs, each countersigned by a different established peer, each planting a yarrow marker on its public record. Entry locks a 40,000 POA bond; quitting or failing a check burns the bond, half to the checking peer, and bars the identity 10 epochs. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 × 40,000 = 40,000,000 POA plus 12,000 wasted tasks; one honest identity pays 40,000 once. The limit is cold start: honest newcomers wait four epochs unpaid while a rich attacker can fund many probations at once.
